value.rationale: D'_n is a historically extremal slowly synchronizing family. The theorem gives an infinite-family structural invariant of its power automaton: an exact unique shortest compression path, a residue-dependent stopping index, and a sharp failure of the universal 3-symbol-per-drop lower bound. This distinguishes early compression dynamics from the much later total reset threshold and is not a routine finite table extension.
